description: OID_EMAIL_ADDRESS (line ~1390 in pkix-path/src/lib.rs) is declared between the section separator comment and the check_name_constraints fn. All other OID constants (OID_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME, OID_NAME_CONSTRAINTS, etc.) are grouped near line 500. A contributor adding a new OID will not find this one unless they grep — and will either define a duplicate or miss it entirely. Move OID_EMAIL_ADDRESS to the OID constant block near the other OIDs.
title: OID_EMAIL_ADDRESS constant buried inside NC enforcement section, not with other OID constants
